steps.name: Checkout exact PR commit with full history
Capture immutable GitHub context
steps.run:
set -u

mkdir -p runtime/generated/evidence

{
  echo "=== GITHUB CONTEXT ==="
  echo "GITHUB_REPOSITORY=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
  echo "GITHUB_REF=$GITHUB_REF"
  echo "GITHUB_REF_NAME=$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
  echo "GITHUB_HEAD_REF=$GITHUB_HEAD_REF"
  echo "GITHUB_BASE_REF=$GITHUB_BASE_REF"
  echo "GITHUB_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA"
  echo "PR_BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
  echo "PR_HEAD_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
  echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
  echo
  echo "=== COMMITS ==="
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git rev-parse "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
  git rev-parse "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
  echo
  echo "=== STATUS ==="
  git status --short --branch
  echo
  echo "=== REMOTES ==="
  git remote -v
  echo
  echo "=== REFS ==="
  git show-ref
  echo
  echo "=== RECENT HISTORY ==="
  git log --oneline --decorate --graph -20
} > runtime/generated/evidence/git-topology.txt

steps.name: Fetch exact PR base commit
steps.run:
set -euxo pipefail

BASE_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"

git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA^{commit}"

echo "BASE_SHA=$BASE_SHA" \
  > runtime/generated/evidence/base-resolution.txt

{
  echo "BASE_SHA=$BASE_SHA"
  echo "BASE_COMMIT:"
  git show -s --format=fuller "$BASE_SHA"
  echo
  echo "HEAD_COMMIT:"
  git show -s --format=fuller HEAD
  echo
  echo "MERGE_BASE:"
  git merge-base HEAD "$BASE_SHA" || echo "MERGE_BASE_NOT_FOUND"
} >> runtime/generated/evidence/base-resolution.txt

steps.name: Compare all Git changed-file calculations
steps.run:
set +e

BASE_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
HEAD_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"

OUT="runtime/generated/evidence/git-diff-comparison.txt"

{
  echo "=================================================="
  echo "EXACT PR BASE / HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  echo "BASE=$BASE_SHA"
  echo "HEAD=$HEAD_SHA"
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "A: THREE-DOT BASE...HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "B: TWO-TREE BASE HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "C: MERGE-BASE...HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  MERGE_BASE="$(git merge-base "$HEAD_SHA" "$BASE_SHA")"
  echo "MERGE_BASE=$MERGE_BASE"
  git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE...$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "D: GITHUB_BASE_REF"
  echo "=================================================="
  if [ -n "${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-}" ]; then
    git diff --name-only "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...$HEAD_SHA"
    echo
    echo "COUNT:"
    git diff --name-only "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  else
    echo "GITHUB_BASE_REF is empty"
  fi
} > "$OUT"

exit 0

steps.name: Black check matrix — four invocations

    "black --check ." \
    "black --check --diff ." \
    "python -m black --check ." \
    "python -m black --check --diff ."
  do
    echo "--------------------------------------------------"
    echo "CMD: $cmd"
    echo "--------------------------------------------------"
    cd backend
    START=$(date +%s%N)
    stdout_file=$(mktemp /tmp/black-matrix-stdout.XXXXXX)
    stderr_file=$(mktemp /tmp/black-matrix-stderr.XXXXXX)
    eval "$cmd" >"$stdout_file" 2>"$stderr_file"
    EXIT=$?
    END=$(date +%s%N)

    echo "EXIT=$EXIT"
    echo "DURATION=${DURATION_S}s"
    echo "--- STDOUT ---"
    cat "$stdout_file"
    echo "--- STDERR ---"
    cat "$stderr_file"
    echo
    rm -f "$stdout_file" "$stderr_file"
  done
} > runtime/generated/evidence/black-check-matrix.txt

steps.name: Emit PR TierPlan manifest (M5-B)
steps.run:
python -m runtime.verify plan \
  --tier pr \
  --base "${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}" \
  --head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --no-write \
  > runtime/generated/vea5-tier-plan.pr.json

steps.name: Run runtime verification (profile)
steps.run: python -m runtime.verify runtime

steps.name: Emit execution-evidence artifact (M5-C / M6-A)
steps.run:
python -m runtime.verify exec-evidence \
  --plan runtime/generated/vea5-tier-plan.pr.json \
  --profile runtime \
  --report runtime/generated/verification-report.md \
  --status "${{ steps.verify.outcome == 'success' && 'pass' || 'fail' }}" \
  --exit "${{ steps.verify.outcome == 'success' && '0' || '1' }}" \
  --duration 0.0 \
  --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --out runtime/generated/vea5-execution.pr.json

steps.name: Reconcile (M5-D / M5-E)
steps.run:
python -m runtime.verify reconcile \
  --plan runtime/generated/vea5-tier-plan.pr.json \
  --evidence runtime/generated/vea5-execution.pr.json \
  --report runtime/generated/vea5-reconciliation.pr.json \
  --commit "$GITHUB_SHA"
